newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Iberia plans mid-Sept 10 ex-Europe cargo.
newsitem.headline: Iberia plans mid-Sept 10 ex-Europe cargo.

text.p: Iberia Cargo plans to increase its ex-Europe air cargo rates by around 10 percent ex-Europe from mid-September, Iberia's cargo manager for the Netherlands manager, Ton Jansen said.
The increase is expected to be from September 15, though it might come earlier, he told Reuters.
The rate rise reflects both booming conditions to Latin America as well as the strength of the dollar which has affected costs, he added.

Dutch air cargo sources said other European and Asian carriers operating out of Amsterdam are also planning autumn rate rises with increases ranging from 10 to 15 percent. - Reuters Air Cargo Service Tel+ 44 171 542 7706 Fax +5017 - www.racs.com
